last.summary: Addressed both review comments. (1) tests/Bzip2/Test/CompressHuffman.lean now uses #guard only: vectors are embedded with include_str and checked by pure Bool functions (agrees: nGroups, selectors, lengths and codes for 7 real blocks with 2..6 tables; mclAgrees: the BZ2_hbMakeCodeLengths calls in mcl.txt, incl. weight-scaling retries). I confirmed a deliberately broken guard fails the build. (2) Huffman.lean module doc and every def doc now cite line ranges I read in upstream: compress.c:273-277 (table count), 283-315 (initial partition), 322-451 (refinement), 399-405 (selector choice, first lowest cost), 447-451 (maxLen 17), 480-492 (codes); huffman.c:33-42, 44-59 (UPHEAP/DOWNHEAP), 63-148, 79-80, 91-110, 114-123, 142-146 (code lengths and retry), 152-166 (assign codes). Also documented that the C fast path (compress.c:359-386, 410-427) is equivalent to the slow path written. Checked: `sh projects/bzip2/tools/verify.sh` printed verify: packages: ok, sources: ok, build: ok, style: ok, axioms: ok, lint: ok, test: ok, then `verify: ok`. git status clean after commit; git diff --stat origin/master...HEAD touches only Huffman.lean, Test/CompressHuffman.lean and tests/vectors/compress-huffman/*.
